column1: # 0x822A1668 -- what a player unit does with its float, one step before it copies
# a pose. Cycle 1341. Fifty instructions, read whole.
# It computes nothing. It is a DISPATCH: for each enabled child, three
# consecutive virtual calls carrying the float.
#       child->vtable[+0xC8] (child, f1)          <- r5 is NOT passed here
# THE GATE IS BIT 0x4000 OF [this+0x60], and it survives the reset: 0x822A1F20
# functions read at different cycles agree about which bits of that word live

column3: skips one child, not the loop

column1: # So the child's vtable is at least 0xCC bytes -- 51 slots -- which already makes
# it a different class from CAce6Unit's 23. Its locator is at child+0x60 where a
# unit's is at +0x80 (cycle 1340). Two independent layout differences.
# WHAT THIS RELOCATES. Slots +0x34 and +0x44 of a unit BUILD a transform from
# angles; slot +0x3C forwards a float to children and then COPIES child[0]'s pose
# back into the unit. So on the player path the transform is not computed in
# CAce6Unit at all -- the unit is a shell that drives children and harvests one.
# NOT ESTABLISHED: what class the children are; what the three slots do; what the
# float is -- it is NOT called delta time here; what r5 is; why the third call
